content.summary: The contract and definitions are suitable for an ordinary computer-assisted proof of the stated maximum-size bound. The manuscript correctly distinguishes arbitrary-support mathematical reductions, shared-builder coefficient replay, independent literal coverage, imported theorems and limited Lean assurance. Bounded integrity and counting checks support the representative Q8 evidence and reported aggregate counts. This Round 1 framing review does not certify all finite models or re-execute their arithmetic.

findings.statement: A matching receipt hash and a strict recorded numerator authenticate local evidence identity and its stated comparison, but do not independently establish the mathematical validity of its model rows. The manuscript explicitly preserves this boundary.
findings.disposition: Retain the shared-builder disclosure and ordinary family-to-model obligations in Sections 3.1 and 7; later review should inspect row construction and replay logic directly.

checks.scope: Frozen Round 1 manuscript, canonical snapshot and 21 named evidence files
checks.method: Computed SHA-256 of manuscript bytes, sorted compact JSON serialization of snapshot.json, and the bytes at every evidence locator using Python 3 standard-library hashing.
checks.observation: The manuscript and canonical snapshot match the supplied hashes; all 21 evidence content hashes match. The pretty-printed snapshot byte hash differs, as expected, from its canonical JSON hash.

checks.scope: Literal theorem, parameter convention and arbitrary-support computation contract
checks.method: Read manuscript Sections 1, 3.1 and 7 and GLOBAL67-dependency-roadmap.md Sections 1 and 2.
checks.observation: The target is finite simple exactly four-uniform families, permits an empty sunflower core, defines M as maximum size, and reduces to exactly 68 by heredity. Proper traces retain exterior multiplicity; represented cores are explicitly not ambient support bounds. The contract identifies imported foundations and does not claim whole-theorem Lean verification.

checks.scope: Representative Q8 complete-coverage receipt: literal finite domains
checks.method: Independently enumerated all four-subsets of 13 represented points and all triples meeting both the six-point Y and seven-point Z using itertools.combinations; compared their bitmasks with the saved absence sets.
checks.observation: P9-Q8-complete-coverage-v9.json contains exactly the expected 715 distinct core four-sets and 231 distinct mixed triples, with set equality for both domains. This checks literal domain completeness, not derivation of every exclusion.

checks.scope: Representative Q8 receipt ancestry, strict comparisons and local bindings
checks.method: Parsed all 94 records, checked each listed predecessor against strictly earlier IDs, compared recorded integer numerator and target, and rehashed each receipt and replay file.
checks.observation: All 94 comparisons are strict; the records comprise 80 trace-upper-bound and 14 zero-infeasibility certificates. All dependencies point backward and all 188 receipt/replay hashes match. E4_56 and E4_57 each have 68 predecessors and the recorded numerators -406255021 and -3584828830 against zero. No coefficient reconstruction was run.

checks.scope: Reported aggregate branch and enumeration counts
checks.method: Recomputed the displayed sums and deletion-domain cardinality with exact integer arithmetic.
checks.observation: The manuscript's degree18 count is 12+34+123=169; degree17 is 12+131+92+94=329; the three size15 trees total 12221 nodes and 384857 checked colour pairs; the cap15 deletion domain is 21*(1+15+binom(15,2))=2541. These are arithmetic consistency checks, not complete enumeration replays.

checks.method: Read degree17_full/q8-negative-controls/results.json and compared its actual listed cases with manuscript Section 3.2.
checks.observation: The saved controls record rejection of missing final mixed-three coverage, a self-dependency and a changed replay hash. The manuscript appropriately limits the inference to these tested failure modes. I did not re-execute these controls in this round.

provenance.tool: collaboration.followup_task; specialist-authored public JSON artifact and observed final response
